subhead: The free practice quizzes and instant-answer camera tool for Clemson's biggest intro courses — point your phone at any quiz question, get the answer explained in seconds.
metaTitle: Clemson University Study Tools & Practice Quizzes | Cambo
metaDescription: Free practice quizzes and instant explained answers for Clemson's most common intro courses — Psych, Econ, Accounting, Bio, Chem, and more.

faqs.q: Is Cambo affiliated with Clemson University?
faqs.a: No. Cambo is an independent study tool, not produced, endorsed, or affiliated with Clemson University.

faqs.q: How often are the course codes on this page updated?
faqs.a: At least once a year, before fall semester — course codes are pulled from each school's official catalog and re-verified annually since schools renumber courses over time.

faqs.q: What courses does this cover at Clemson?
faqs.a: This page links out to free practice quizzes for Clemson's most-searched intro courses — things like introductory psychology, macroeconomics, financial accounting, and general biology or chemistry. Pick a course below to start practicing.

faqs.q: Do I need to create an account to try a practice quiz?
faqs.a: No — the practice quizzes on this page are free with no signup required. Creating a free account is only needed for Cambo's camera-capture tool, which gives you an instant explained answer to any question you point your phone at in real time.
